description: Who owns more than 5 percent of a company, from Schedules 13D and 13G: each holder's latest stake (shares, percent of class, voting power), whether it is passive (13G) or may seek to influence control (13D, with its stated purpose); or, with no company, the newest 13D stakes across the whole market.

company.description: Ticker, CIK or name. Without it, the latest filings across the whole market (new activist stakes by default).

schedule.description: 13D (may seek to influence control; states its purpose), 13G (passive) or both. Default: both for a company, 13D across the market.

since.description: Filed on or after this date; default three years ago for a company, seven days ago across the market.

name: large_holders

outputSchema.description: rows are holders (latest filing each, largest stake first) or, across the market, filings; percent_of_class is a fraction.

title: Large holders (13D/13G)
